rows.english: Estimates include the current canvas and clipboard, sampled decoding and editing buffers. Actual memory use varies. A smaller copy loses detail. The original file stays unchanged.
rows.raw: Gi katkulasion, mana\'danña\' i RAM para i brin ni un usa på\'gu yan i kopia ni mapo\'lu para u mapega (clipboard), yan i tempuråriu na kåmpu gi RAM para u mababa i pinenta gi mineddung ni siña mås dikiki\' (sampled decoding) yan para u matulaika i pinenta. Gi minagåhit, ti todu i tiempu parehu i RAM ni ma\'usa. Yanggin mås dikiki\' i mineddung i kopia, malingu palu na infutmasion gi kopia. Ti matulaika i urihinåt na dokumentu.

Gi minagåhit, ti todu i tiempu parehu i RAM ni ma'usa. Yanggin mås dikiki' i mineddung i kopia, malingu palu na infutmasion gi kopia. Ti matulaika i urihinåt na dokumentu.
rows.backtranslation: The estimate includes RAM for the canvas you currently use and the copy stored for pasting (clipboard), and temporary RAM space for opening the image at dimensions that may be smaller (sampled decoding) and for changing the image. In reality, the RAM used is not always the same. If the dimensions of the copy are smaller, some information is lost in the copy. The original file is unchanged.

rows.raw: AN Paint quiixnehuia quezqui RAM monequi. Quicempohua RAM para ixcopincayotl tlen namantzin eltoc (canvas), para tlen quiahcoucqui para quipepechoz (clipboard), huan RAM tlen motequihuia ce tlatoctzin quemman quitlapoa ixcopincayotl (sampled decoding: hueli quipatla ihuexca para ma eli maz cuecuetztzin) huan quemman quipatla ixcopincayotl. Itlapohual RAM tlen motequihuia axnochipa cencah. Tlan AN Paint quichihua ce ixcopincayotl ica ihuexca tlen maz cuecuetztzin (px), polihui cequi tlen neci. AN Paint axquipatla ixcopincayotl tlen achtohui (original file).

Itlapohual RAM tlen motequihuia axnochipa cencah. Tlan AN Paint quichihua ce ixcopincayotl ica ihuexca tlen maz cuecuetztzin (px), polihui cequi tlen neci. AN Paint axquipatla ixcopincayotl tlen achtohui (original file).
rows.backtranslation: AN Paint estimates how much RAM is needed. It counts together RAM for the current image (canvas), for what it stored for pasting (clipboard), and temporary RAM when opening an image (sampled decoding: it can change its dimensions to smaller ones) and when changing an image. The amount of RAM used is not always the same. If AN Paint makes an image with smaller pixel dimensions, some visible information is lost. AN Paint does not change the original image/file.
rows.caller: ImageResizeDialog.kt:34 displays this for non-native-memory prompts; target39 permits dimensions equal to source and refresh40–57 uses current policy each time. ImageImport.kt ImportPlan.create initializes sample=1 and may leave it at1. Therefore neither actual decoding reduction nor a smaller final target is universally asserted.

semantic_limits: Technical anchors RAM, canvas, clipboard, sampled decoding, px and original file retain exact software referents beside functional wording. They are not claimed Chicontepec dictionary terms.
The original file remains distinct from the smaller image produced. Estimate is not reported as measured actual use; actual amount can vary.

quicempohua applies counting-together to requirements, not simultaneous actual peak allocation of every independent intermediate. The caller uses maxima/reserves; the wording describes inclusion, not a literal arithmetic assertion that all buffers sum simultaneously.

maz cuecuetztzin combines own source degree and own small; not an attested whole collocation. Existing HUEXCA size convention and px establish dimension reduction, not quality/byte compression or zoom.
IXNEHUIA is own estimating without measurement; the source example is human planning, so applying it to software is an openly authored semantic extension. No literal machine cognition claim.
No source-file change, restoration guarantee, successful retry claim, native/layout/runtime certificate.

The v1 reduced-decoding assertion was too strong for sample=1. This v2 supersedes that assertion only; previous lexical evidence remains. Smaller-copy detail loss now explicitly conditional, including target==source paths.
HUELI can/may states possible capability, not an observed action or guarantee. TLAN1 conditional plus present quichihua is directly corroborated by the dictionary introduction.
